rows.en: It's like Lynn Minmay has returned. Withdrawing.
rows.notes: Transcript kanji garbled ('rinmin mei'); read as Lynn Minmay.

rows.en: Well done, Captain.
We'll follow the Captain, too!
You've come a long way, you know.
Take care not to drag us down.
I don't want any stupid mistakes.
We'll see how far we get when we can't even coordinate.
We start the operation, too. Are you ready?
Looks like it has to be done. Follow me.
We must make this operation a success.
With your skill, this operation is no problem.
Show me everything you can do.
It may be a tough operation, but we'll do our best.
Ready, you lot? Today's prey is those guys. So to speak.
We'll show them our strength.
You're the key to this operation, no exaggeration. I'm counting on you!
Next time I need you to do better.
You did well to make it back in one piece.
Our coordination problems stood out, as expected.
The operation is a success. Well done.
Not a bad hand, but you can do better.
Don't settle for success. Keep working at it.
With our strength, this much is to be expected.
Keep up the good work.
Quite a skill. I'll rely on you next time too.
It seems you helped me a great deal.
Just like me in my younger days. Ha ha ha! Just kidding.
Keep it up! As the ace pilot we pin our hopes on!
Looks like it'll be a tough operation.
I have concerns, but it seems it's up to you.
The odds are low, but we have no choice but to try.
Well, are you prepared?
You should be able to pull this off.
We'll make them feel our power.
We must carry out the operation. I'm counting on you.
We'll make them pay.
You're an odd one, wanting to fight alongside us.
Live up to my expectations.
Let's go. The odds are on our side.
Sorry, but I'm going to have you do something a bit reckless.
Hardly a result you could call good.
It was a bad bet, but it seems we won.
rows.notes: Transcript 'budou warui' read as 'bun no warui' (long odds).

rows.en: This was a victory close to a miracle.
We won this operation!
Keep it up next time too.
The operation succeeded. We return at once, too.
Well done. I thank you for your work.
A victory we seized together. Let's savor it.
I should learn from your strength.
You'll make a good wife.
rows.notes: Literal 'ii okusan ni naru na'; addressee is the player partner (gender not given); kept literal.

rows.en: If only I were a little younger.
You really stopped the war. Admirable work.
Everyone, sadly this is no exercise. All units equip Super Packs. The Captain's unit may use the Armored Pack.
rows.notes: Transcript opens 'shougun' (general); read as 'shokun' (everyone) as in clip 101.

rows.en: Everyone, the enemy is yesterday's survivors. They're already inside our guard, fighting within fleet space. Show your full strength!
Quarter to all sortied units. This ship is about to engage the Vajra carrier at close quarters.
We'll take the biggest prey ourselves. All ships, transform!
Show them why this 400-meter Quarter bears the Macross name. No, why a Macross is only this size!
Prepare to fire the Macross Cannon.
Blast them!
Listen, everyone: this is a do-or-die stand. Not a single one gets through the defense line!
rows.notes: Transcript 'haisui no jin' (drain) read as 'haisui' = back-to-the-wall; 'bouei-sen' read as 'bouei-sen' (line).

rows.en: All ships, transform!
Delta One to all S.M.S. units. We're launching an all-out attack on the main enemy force that appeared to our rear.
Alto, you're cleared to use the Armored Pack and reaction missiles. But we won't ease our own attack. Show your strength!
rows.notes: Transcript 'Alto junni' (rank?) read as 'Alto junni'; kept as the name only; 'hannoudan' = reaction missiles.

rows.en: As of now, we turn from soldiers to pirates. Our first prey is this ship. Let's go, you lot!
rows.notes: Transcript 'genji koku' read as 'genjikoku' (the present time).

rows.en: Sorry, I can't do that.
When everyone looks right, I can't help but want to look from the left.
We're back, to crush the ambitions of Galaxy, of Grace O'Connor, and of those who side with them.
We were being played. By their conspiracy and those who took part in it.
All soldiers! The Vajra aren't our true enemy! Galaxy hijacked the Vajra Queen. Grace O'Connor and her people are! Those proud of their wings, follow me!
rows.notes: Transcript 'Grace O'Kora'; read as O'Connor. Run-on speech compressed to fit.

rows.en: Now! Macross Attack!
Sleep now, my friend. Farewell. We'll meet again.
Weigh anchor! Release stabilizers! Slow ahead!
rows.notes: Transcript 'ikari o agero' (raise anger) read as 'ikari o ageru' (weigh anchor); 'sutamiraizaa' read as 'stabilizer'.

rows.en: S.M.S. Macross Quarter, launching.
Don't let your guard down!
Show them how S.M.S. fights!
Sorry, but we can't let you get away.
Blast them!
Fire!
rows.notes: Transcript 'tiaa'; read as 'faia' (fire!), as it sits between 'blast them' and 'Macross Cannon, fire'.

rows.en: Macross Cannon, fire!
Looks like you underestimated our power.
